title: Moonrot Cauldron Slime
tagline: Troll toenails, cyclops eyes and one very tired sock.

ingredients.item: witch's old stripy sock, well worn

steps: Tip the toenails in with a clickety-clack, then stir to the left and never look back.
Drop three cyclops eyes in, plop, plop, plop, and watch them all bob round the top.
Tip the ogre's boot sludge in with a squelch, then add the goblin bogeys, one stringy belch.
Drape in my sock, it's a stinker, it's true, then fluff in the cobwebs, a sticky grey goo.
Stir thirteen times as the moonbeams pour, till the glitter goes bang and it burps once more.
rhyme:
Round the rim and widdershins we creep,
Troll toenails in, a crusty heap.
Cyclops eyeballs, plop, plop, plop,
Bobbing round the slimy top.
Goblin bogeys, stringy and green,
The grottiest jar you've ever seen.
Scoop of sludge from an ogre's boot,
Then my old sock, a smelly hoot.
Cobweb fluff and a dragon-scale sprinkle,
Stir till the whole lot starts to twinkle.
image_prompt: A big black iron cauldron on mossy stones, brimming with glowing lime-green slime. Three oversized cartoon eyeballs bob on top, a stripy holey sock droops over the rim, grey cobweb candyfloss clings to the handle, and glittering dragon scales sparkle in the ooze. Purple mist curls over the edge. No flames.
alt_text: A black cauldron full of glowing green slime with bobbing giant eyeballs, a stripy sock over the rim, grey cobwebs and purple mist.
caption_hook:
The witch let me watch her make this one. I've never seen a sock do that before.
Which ingredient would you sneak into her cauldron?
